item.title: Malaysia Airlines: Where Warmth Truly Takes Flight
item.description: Long-haul travel rarely feels intuitive, let alone indulgent. item.title: “For me, the real muse is the unexpected pairing”: Dhruv Kapoor from Milan
item.description: Disruption is Dhruv Kapoor’s native language. He has always spoken it fluently: clashing sublime with sensual, superimposing sophisticated with street, juxtaposing utilitarian with theatrical – one could always trust the global brand to dazzle its growing legion of fans with the unexpected and the avant-garde. For his recently showcased Fall Winter 26-27 collection titled “Process & Observations” at Milan Fashion Week, the designer began with an acute interest in the idea of transit and waiting.
